airport_records.name: Key West International (1986)
airport_records.location_note: County history identifies the southeastern Key West airfield, formerly Meacham Field, and its pre-1986 civilian identity. Distinct from Boca Chica/NQX and seaplane bases. IATA code is explicitly printed in both 1986 timetables. Modern coordinates are approximate airfield markers, not a reconstruction of 1986 runways or terminals.
